supportedRuntimes.orchestration: Docker Engine with Docker Compose v2

testedPlatforms.platform: Local source build on macOS arm64
testedPlatforms.coverage: Automated source checks and disposable PostgreSQL/browser acceptance; see release notes for measured results.

knownLimitations: Source candidate only. No 0.5.0 images have been published or accepted for stable promotion.
Battery history is a BMS rated-range estimate relative to the first month with usable range observations, not a battery-health test or a comparison with a new battery.
Battery range history requires TeslaMate post-charge rated-range data; imports without these measurements remain unavailable.
Native Raspberry Pi, linux/amd64, multi-architecture image and exact published-image upgrade acceptance remain release gates.
Charging efficiency and costs depend on paired energy observations and known prices; currencies are never converted or inferred.
